correctness.rationale: For fixed 0<=t<1, C_t=D(I-tS)^(-1), D=diag(1/(n+1)), and D is compact with singular sequence 1/n. For every finite cutoff A_m=sum_{r=0}^m t^r S^r, the printed block decomposition of DA_m is valid: P0DA_m finite rank; within-block diagonal error trace class by summing (r+1)/(kB)^2; each cross-boundary strip has rank <=m and norm <=M/(kB+1), giving epsilon N(epsilon,R)<=mM/B; block direct sum Q_B/(kB) gives the exact coefficient ||Q_B||_1/B; Q_B differs from a circulant by rank <=m and the normalized trace norm tends to the Fourier-symbol modulus mean. Sending B to infinity and the Ky Fan perturbation tolerance to zero yields epsilon N(epsilon,DA_m) -> c_m. The analytic-symbol tail has s_n(D(A-A_m))<=t^(m+1)/((1-t)n); Ky Fan inequalities let m tend to infinity, yielding epsilon N(epsilon,C_t)->c(t). The standard monotone counting inversion yields n s_n(C_t)->c(t)>0. The integral equals 2 K(2 sqrt(t)/(1+t))/(pi(1+t)), with K modulus convention; checked at t=0 and by independent quadrature and 240x240 singular-value calculations for t=0.3,0.7. Thus log partial sums, membership S_{1,infty} and all S_q (q>1), and nonmembership S_1 follow. Finite sections only corroborate; all fixed t<1 and the real/complex versions are proved, not uniform t->1 or t=1.
